use default
use Math = System.Math
use Raster.Anchor
use Raster.AXES
use Raster.IMAGE

hailstone(n: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    let current mut = n

    while true do
        yield current

        if current == 1 then
            return
        fi

        current =
            if current % 2 == 0 then current / 2 else 3 * current + 1 fi
    od
si

let limit = 100_000

let lengths =
    (1::limit) |> map(n => hailstone(n) |> count()) |> collect()

let peak =
    lengths
    |> index()
    |> map(entry => (n = entry.index + 1, steps = entry.value))
    |> reduce((n = 0, steps = 0),
        (best, item) => if item.steps > best.steps then item
                        else best
                        fi)

let tallest = peak.steps
let longest = peak.n

let image = IMAGE(860, 520)

image.view(
    0.0, 0.0,
    cast double(limit), cast double(tallest) + 18.0,
    62.0)

image.colour(80ub, 80ub, 80ub)
image.stroke(1.0)

let axes = AXES(image)

axes.x_title = "n"
axes.y_title = "steps"
axes.draw()

image.colour(40ub, 70ub, 150ub)
image.stroke(1.1)

for entry in lengths |> index() do
    let x = cast double(entry.index + 1)
    let y = cast double(entry.value)

    image.line(x, y, x, y)
od

let marked_x = cast double(longest)
let marked_y = cast double(tallest)

image.colour(200ub, 40ub, 40ub)
image.stroke(6.0)
image.line(marked_x, marked_y, marked_x, marked_y)

image.text(marked_x, marked_y + 7.0, 13.0, "{longest}", Anchor.CENTRE)

image.write("hailstone.png")

image.show("hailstone.png")
